meaning.en: This śloka praises Lalitā as Truth, knowledge and bliss, Immersed in a state of steady wisdom, Wife of kapardi (shiva, one with matted hair), Wearing all sixty-four forms of art as a garland, fulfills all desires, and a desirable form. meaning.en: This śloka praises Lalitā as lords over the five prANas and the senses, Giver of life, fifty centers of worship, Unfettered, free in every way, abides in secluded places, Mother of the valiant, and Mother to the ether. meaning.en: This śloka praises Lalitā as Support of the code for righteous living, oversees wealth, increases wealth and harvests, Fond of the learned, In the form of a knower of the self, and makes the universe go around through Her power of illusion. Rather than presenting unrelated titles, the verse gathers these qualities into one vision of the Divine Mother.
meaning.kn: ಈ ಶ್ಲೋಕವು ಲಲಿತೆಯನ್ನು dharmādhārā, dhanādhyakṣā, dhanadhānyavivardhinī, viprapriyā, viprarūpā, viśvabhramaṇakāriṇī ಎಂಬ ನಾಮಗಳಿಂದ ಸ್ತುತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ನಾಮಗಳು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ವಿಶೇಷಣಗಳಲ್ಲ; ಒಂದೇ ದಿವ್ಯಮಾತೆಯ ಪರಸ್ಪರಪೂರಕ ಸ್ವರೂಪಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

deeper.en:

The verse therefore invites a unified contemplation of Lalitā—as the personal Mother who can be loved and worshipped, and as the consciousness that ultimately exceeds every name used to praise Her.

meaning.kn: ಈ ಶ್ಲೋಕವು ಲಲಿತೆಯನ್ನು savyāpasavyamārgasthā, sarvāpadvinivāriṇī, svasthā, svabhāvamadhurā, dhīrā, dhīrasamarcitā ಎಂಬ ನಾಮಗಳಿಂದ ಸ್ತುತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ನಾಮಗಳು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ವಿಶೇಷಣಗಳಲ್ಲ; ಒಂದೇ ದಿವ್ಯಮಾತೆಯ ಪರಸ್ಪರಪೂರಕ ಸ್ವರೂಪಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

meaning.en: This śloka praises Lalitā as sky as Her hair, Seated in Her celestial chariot; She who journeys in Her celestial chariot along with the gods, bears the vajrA (thunderbolt) weapon, Presiding deity of the vamakeshvara tantra, Fond of the five forms of sacrifices (agnihotrA, darshapUrnamAsa, chAturmAsya, goyaj~na and somayaj~na), and reclines on a couch made of the five corpses. Rather than presenting unrelated titles, the verse gathers these qualities into one vision of the Divine Mother.
meaning.kn: ಈ ಶ್ಲೋಕವು ಲಲಿತೆಯನ್ನು vyomakeśī, vimānasthā, vajriṇī, vāmakeśvarī, pañcayajñapriyā, pañcapretamañcādhiśāyinī ಎಂಬ ನಾಮಗಳಿಂದ ಸ್ತುತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ನಾಮಗಳು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ವಿಶೇಷಣಗಳಲ್ಲ; ಒಂದೇ ದಿವ್ಯಮಾತೆಯ ಪರಸ್ಪರಪೂರಕ ಸ್ವರೂಪಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

deeper.en:
Taken together, the names in this verse develop the devotional contemplation of Her form, a distinct aspect of Her divine nature, sacred knowledge and mantra. Each epithet contributes a particular facet, so the movement of the śloka is cumulative: Lalitā is contemplated not only through a single attribute but as the Reality in which these dimensions meet.

The deeper Śrīvidyā reading is that form, power, knowledge and transcendence are not separate compartments of the Goddess. They are different ways the one Śakti becomes knowable to the devotee. The verse therefore invites a unified contemplation of Lalitā—as the personal Mother who can be loved and worshipped, and as the consciousness that ultimately exceeds every name used to praise Her.

meaning.kn: ಈ ಶ್ಲೋಕವು ಲಲಿತೆಯನ್ನು āśobhanā, śuddhamānasā, bindutarpaṇasantuṣṭā, pūrvajā, tripurāmbikā ಎಂಬ ನಾಮಗಳಿಂದ ಸ್ತುತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ನಾಮಗಳು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ವಿಶೇಷಣಗಳಲ್ಲ; ಒಂದೇ ದಿವ್ಯಮಾತೆಯ ಪರಸ್ಪರಪೂರಕ ಸ್ವರೂಪಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

ಶ್ರೀವಿದ್ಯೆಯ ಆಳವಾದ ದೃಷ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ರೂಪ, ಶಕ್ತಿ, ಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಾತ್ಪರತೆ ದೇವಿಯ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳಲ್ಲ. ಒಂದೇ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಭಕ್ತನಿಗೆ ಅರಿವಾಗುವ ವಿಭಿನ್ನ ದ್ವಾರಗಳಾಗಿವೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಈ ಶ್ಲೋಕವು ಪ್ರೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಆರಾಧಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಆಪ್ತಮಾತೆಯನ್ನೂ, ಎಲ್ಲ ನಾಮರೂಪಗಳಿಗೂ ಮೀರಿರುವ ಚೈತನ್ಯಸ್ವರೂಪಿಣಿಯನ್ನೂ ಒಂದೇ ಲಲಿತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

meaning.en: This śloka praises Lalitā as Auspicious and divine shiva, Union of shiva and shaktI into one form, and Divine mother lalitA. Rather than presenting unrelated titles, the verse gathers these qualities into one vision of the Divine Mother.
meaning.kn: ಈ ಶ್ಲೋಕವು ಲಲಿತೆಯನ್ನು śrīśivā, śivaśaktaikyarūpiṇī, lalitāmbikā ಎಂಬ ನಾಮಗಳಿಂದ ಸ್ತುತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ನಾಮಗಳು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ವಿಶೇಷಣಗಳಲ್ಲ; ಒಂದೇ ದಿವ್ಯಮಾತೆಯ ಪರಸ್ಪರಪೂರಕ ಸ್ವರೂಪಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

deeper.en:
Taken together, the names in this verse develop the inseparability of Śiva and Śakti, the Divine Mother. Each epithet contributes a particular facet, so the movement of the śloka is cumulative: Lalitā is contemplated not only through a single attribute but as the Reality in which these dimensions meet.

The deeper Śrīvidyā reading is that form, power, knowledge and transcendence are not separate compartments of the Goddess. They are different ways the one Śakti becomes knowable to the devotee. The verse therefore invites a unified contemplation of Lalitā—as the personal Mother who can be loved and worshipped, and as the consciousness that ultimately exceeds every name used to praise Her.
